settings.editor: AI is becoming part of how businesses build, operate, and make decisions—but new AI capabilities introduce new security risks. Our AI security services help you assess those risks, strengthen governance, protect sensitive data, secure AI applications and agents, and test AI systems against real-world attacks.
Know Where Your AI Security Risks Begin
Assess your AI environment, applications, data flows, models, integrations, and controls to identify security weaknesses before they become operational or business risks.

AI adoption can move faster than your policies and controls. Establish practical governance that defines how AI is used, how risks are managed, and how security responsibilities are maintained as AI adoption expands.
Protect the Data Behind Your AI

AI systems can process sensitive business information, customer data, intellectual property, and confidential content. We assess how data moves through AI environments and help strengthen controls around access, handling, storage, and exposure.
Secure AI Applications Before They Become Attack Targets

AI-powered applications and LLMs introduce attack paths that traditional application security may not fully address. We assess AI applications for weaknesses such as prompt injection, data exposure, insecure integrations, and unsafe model interactions.
Secure AI Agents Before They Act on Your Behalf

AI agents can access systems, use tools, process information, and take actions with limited human intervention. We assess agent permissions, tools, workflows, integrations, and decision boundaries to identify risks before they can affect your environment.
Test AI Systems Like an Attacker Would
AI red teaming puts your AI applications, models, agents, and controls under adversarial testing to uncover weaknesses that conventional security assessments may miss.

settings.title: From Assessment to Full Management in Days, Not Months

settings.editor: We start by understanding your AI environment, use cases, architecture, data flows, applications, models, and existing security controls.
We identify security risks and map them to the appropriate governance, technical, and organizational controls.
Where required, we test AI applications, LLMs, agents, integrations, and controls to validate whether identified risks can be exploited.
We provide prioritized recommendations and practical guidance to strengthen your AI security posture.

settings.title: AI Security Across the AI Lifecycle

settings.editor: AI security needs to evolve as your AI capabilities evolve. Our approach helps address risk from initial assessment and governance through application deployment, agent adoption, and ongoing security testing.
Understand your AI environment, use cases, architecture, and security exposure.
Establish policies, controls, responsibilities, and risk management processes.
Strengthen the security of AI data, applications, models, agents, and integrations.
Continuously challenge AI systems through adversarial testing and red teaming.
Not Sure Where Your AI Security Gaps Are?
Start with an AI Security Assessment. We'll help you understand your current exposure, identify the highest-priority risks, and establish a practical path toward more secure AI adoption.
